name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: ordering and kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the coverage disappears. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service from.

Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook and then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T MANAGE
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as the pre-orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to cook now, what is next in line and what is ready, with a notification when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or via your local network, and the order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE COVERAGE DISAPPEARS
Switch on offline protection, and pre-orders pause if the connection breaks, so nobody can place an order you don't see. Orders you take on the device are saved and synced when you are online again.

BUILT FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each one of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
